decision: Accept only reduced trial C in Candidate22. Full experiments are not promoted.
observations: Reduced chest/shoulder contour is smoother during attack and windup, with less abrupt pinching beside the neck.
Front, opposite and back contact sheets show ordinary clips retain the existing silhouette; textured shoulder patches and elbow folding remain visible.
Reference pixels were inspected directly. Protruding eye whites, muzzle/lid shapes, simplified wing membranes and straight tail profile still differ; no rest-shape likeness change is claimed.
Production ground/flight comparison keeps root/camera/action timing matched. The full-page real-loop screenshot is supplemental, not a matched comparison.
Full-resolution A adds a compressed stagger triangle; full C adds a compressed turn triangle. Those trials remain unaccepted despite improved stretch metrics.
limits: Curated stills and contact sheets supplement sampled numerical checks. They do not prove absence of all self-intersection, all camera angles or all physical-device faults.
